panels.title: Anzahl Sensoren
panels.description: Sensoren = alle bekannten Gruppen. Aktiv = Messwert in den letzten 5 Minuten. Status aus iiot/group/+/status.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sensoren, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN last_seen >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS REAL) - 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS aktiv, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_ok, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('error','offline') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gestoert FROM devices
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sensoren, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN last_seen >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS REAL) - 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS aktiv, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_ok, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('error','offline') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gestoert FROM devices

panels.title: Geräteübersicht
panels.description: Alle Gruppen, unabhängig vom gewählten Zeitraum. Status: letzte Nachricht auf iiot/group/<gruppe>/status; letzte Verbindung: letzter Messwert.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT group_name AS gruppe, status, status_updated_at, last_seen, ROUND(last_value, 2) AS letzter_wert, unit AS einheit, CASE WHEN last_seen >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS REAL) - 300 THEN 'aktiv' ELSE 'inaktiv' END AS aktivitaet FROM devices ORDER BY (status IN ('error','offline')) DESC, last_seen IS NULL, last_seen DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT group_name AS gruppe, status, status_updated_at, last_seen, ROUND(last_value, 2) AS letzter_wert, unit AS einheit, CASE WHEN last_seen >= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS REAL) - 300 THEN 'aktiv' ELSE 'inaktiv' END AS aktivitaet FROM devices ORDER BY (status IN ('error','offline')) DESC, last_seen IS NULL, last_seen DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(time / MAX(1, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS INTEGER) * MAX(1, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN unit='K' THEN value-273.15 ELSE value END) AS value, group_name || ' / ' || sensor_id AS metric FROM readings WHERE group_name IN (${group:sqlstring}) AND metric='temperature' AND unit IN ('°C','K') AND time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1, group_name, sensor_id ORDER BY 1
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(time / MAX(1, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS INTEGER) * MAX(1, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN unit='K' THEN value-273.15 ELSE value END) AS value, group_name || ' / ' || sensor_id AS metric FROM readings WHERE group_name IN (${group:sqlstring}) AND metric='temperature' AND unit IN ('°C','K') AND time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1, group_name, sensor_id ORDER BY 1

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT group_name, sensor_id, metric, unit, COUNT(*) AS samples, ROUND(MIN(value), 2) AS minimum, ROUND(MAX(value), 2) AS maximum, ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS average FROM readings WHERE group_name IN (${group:sqlstring}) AND time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY group_name,sensor_id,metric,unit

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT received_at AS time, topic, qos, retained, parse_error FROM messages ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT group_name, sensor_id, metric, value, unit, time, time_source FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_name,sensor_id,metric ORDER BY time DESC,id DESC) AS position FROM readings WHERE group_name IN (${group:sqlstring}) AND time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000) WHERE position=1
